projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
A new analytics dashboard initiative that ingests and processes customer CSV files, analyzes application log data, and surfaces insights through visualization components. The project is structured into five milestones: foundation/architecture, customer CSV data processing, application log analysis, visualization components, and integration/testing/deployment.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-processing, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: Milestone 1: Foundation & Architecture Setup
tasks.details: Establish the technical foundation for the analytics dashboard: architecture decisions, technology stack, repository/CI setup, and shared data schemas that all downstream pipelines and UI work will depend on.

tasks.name: Milestone 2: Customer CSV Data Processing
tasks.details: Build the end-to-end pipeline for ingesting customer CSV files: file intake, schema validation, parsing/normalization, cleaning/deduplication, persistence, and data-quality monitoring.

tasks.name: Milestone 3: Application Log Analysis
tasks.details: Build the log analytics pipeline: collect and ingest application logs, parse and structure them, aggregate metrics, detect anomalies/errors, and store/index results for querying.

tasks.name: Milestone 4: Visualization Components
tasks.details: Design and build the dashboard UI: UX/layout, a reusable chart component library, customer-data views, log-analytics views, and interactive filtering/drill-down/export capabilities.

tasks.name: Milestone 5: Integration, Testing & Deployment
tasks.details: Umbrella milestone for coordinating the already-broken-down workstreams: pipeline/API integration, unit & integration testing, performance/load testing, security review, staged deployment, and documentation handover. All execution work is tracked in the six child tasks (each complexity ≤5).

tasks.name: Define architecture and technology stack
tasks.details: Document the system architecture (ingestion, processing, storage, API, UI layers), select the tech stack and libraries for CSV processing, log analytics, storage, and visualization, and record key decisions and trade-offs in an ADR.

tasks.name: Set up repository, CI/CD, and dev environments
tasks.details: Create the code repository with linting/formatting, branch protection, CI pipeline (build, test, static analysis), and reproducible local/staging development environments.

tasks.name: Define shared data schemas and contracts
tasks.details: Define canonical schemas for customer CSV records, parsed log events, aggregated metrics, and dashboard API responses. Document field types, nullability, and versioning so pipelines and UI stay in sync.

tasks.name: Build CSV ingestion and file intake service
tasks.details: Implement secure upload/discovery of customer CSV files, with file metadata capture, idempotent intake IDs, size/type checks, and archival of raw files.

tasks.name: Implement CSV schema validation and error handling
tasks.details: Validate headers, required fields, data types, and row-level constraints against the shared schema. Produce clear per-row error reports and quarantine invalid records without failing the whole batch.

tasks.name: Implement CSV parsing and normalization
tasks.details: Parse CSV rows into the canonical customer schema, normalize dates, currencies, locales, and encodings, and handle large files in a streaming/chunked manner.

tasks.name: Implement data cleaning and deduplication
tasks.details: Apply trimming, null/default handling, and fuzzy/normalized matching to identify and merge duplicate customer records. Define and apply a deterministic dedup precedence policy.

tasks.name: Persist processed customer data to storage
tasks.details: Load cleaned, normalized customer records into the chosen database/warehouse with upsert semantics, indexing, and transactional batch writes.

tasks.name: Build data-quality monitoring and reporting
tasks.details: Track ingestion counts, validation pass/fail rates, duplicate rates, and freshness; expose a data-quality summary report and alert on threshold breaches.

tasks.name: Configure log collection and ingestion
tasks.details: Set up collection of application logs from files/streams, define ingestion cadence and retention, and handle backpressure, retries, and offset checkpoints.

tasks.name: Build log parsing and structuring pipeline
tasks.details: Parse raw log lines (JSON and plain-text formats) into the canonical log-event schema: timestamp, level, service, correlation ID, message, and attributes. Handle malformed lines gracefully.

tasks.name: Implement log aggregation and metrics computation
tasks.details: Compute counts, error rates, latency percentiles, and per-service/time-bucket aggregates from parsed log events; materialize results for fast dashboard querying.

tasks.name: Implement anomaly and error detection rules
tasks.details: Define configurable rules/thresholds for error spikes, unusual patterns, and anomaly scoring; generate alerts and annotate events for the dashboard.

tasks.name: Store and index processed logs
tasks.details: Persist structured log events and aggregates in a searchable store with sensible indexes/partitions and retention policy for efficient filtered queries.

tasks.name: Design dashboard UX, layout, and navigation
tasks.details: Create wireframes for the dashboard shell, navigation, and key screens (customer overview, log health, alerts), including responsive behavior and accessibility considerations.

tasks.name: Build reusable chart component library
tasks.details: Implement a shared set of chart components (line, bar, pie, table, KPI tile) with consistent theming, loading/empty states, and reusable data-binding interfaces.

tasks.name: Implement customer analytics dashboard views
tasks.details: Build views for customer counts, segments, growth trends, and data-quality indicators, wired to the customer data API using the shared chart library.

tasks.name: Implement log analytics dashboard views
tasks.details: Build views for log volume, error rates, latency trends, top errors, and anomaly alerts, wired to the log analytics API.

tasks.name: Add filtering, drill-down, and export
tasks.details: Add global and per-widget filters (date range, segment, service), drill-down into underlying records, and CSV/PDF export of dashboard views.

tasks.name: Integrate data pipelines with dashboard APIs
tasks.details: Expose customer and log analytics results through dashboard API endpoints, connect the frontend views end-to-end, and verify data freshness and error handling.

tasks.name: Write unit and integration test suite
tasks.details: Cover CSV parsing/validation/dedup, log parsing/aggregation, API endpoints, and UI components with unit tests plus end-to-end integration tests using representative fixtures.

tasks.name: Run performance and load testing
tasks.details: Benchmark CSV ingestion and log processing at expected peak volumes, test dashboard query/response times, and tune bottlenecks; document results against targets.

tasks.name: Conduct security and access control review
tasks.details: Review authentication/authorization, secrets handling, PII protection in customer data and logs, input validation, and dependency vulnerabilities; remediate findings.

tasks.name: Deploy to staging and production
tasks.details: Roll out via CI/CD to staging for validation, then production; configure monitoring, alerting, logging, backups, and a rollback plan.

tasks.name: Write documentation and handover guide
tasks.details: Document architecture, data schemas, pipeline operations, dashboard usage, runbooks for common alerts, and onboarding instructions for the operations team.
